responsibility: This file defines H8/300 zero-extension and sign-extension expanders and instruction patterns for promoting QI to HI/SI and HI to SI values, with separate handling for classic cores and H8SX. It is responsible for lowering extend and zero_extend RTL into extu/exts instructions or multi-step splits when overlaps or memory sources require them, while also providing CC-setting variants that compare-elimination can reuse and ensuring post-reload decomposition produces accurate lengths and mergeable end-of-block sequences.
